tests.name: WASD is camera relative; every cardinal and diagonal has unit speed
diagonal displacement equals cardinal displacement
boundaries retain the entire player collider on all four sides
solid obstacles stop movement from every side without tunneling
collision permits sliding along an obstacle and handles rounded corners
living dummy blocks movement; dead dummy does not
attack rejects invalid target and out-of-range dummy without consuming cooldown
attack accepts exact range, rejects beyond it, and enforces cooldown
dummy death clamps health, rejects attacks, and reset restores all match state
fixed timestep gives the same displacement at 30, 60, and 144 render FPS
clock clamps catch-up and reset removes suspended-tab time
Nearest Enemy selects dummy-a from meaningful training data
Lowest Current HP selects dummy-b from meaningful training data
Lowest HP Percentage selects dummy-c from meaningful training data
Manual Target selects dummy-a from meaningful training data
only valid, living, targetable enemy units qualify
nearest: in-range eligible target is preferred to an out-of-range lower-HP unit
current-hp: in-range eligible target is preferred to an out-of-range lower-HP unit
hp-percent: in-range eligible target is preferred to an out-of-range lower-HP unit
manual: in-range eligible target is preferred to an out-of-range lower-HP unit
nearest: ties use distance then stable ID, independent of array order
current-hp: ties use distance then stable ID, independent of array order
hp-percent: ties use distance then stable ID, independent of array order
manual: ties use distance then stable ID, independent of array order
manual click overrides each auto mode and ground attacks preserve that lock
Manual Target mode pins a specific target and reselects nearest after death
changing modes or clearing a lock returns to that automatic policy without resetting cooldown
dead/invalid target is never selected; invalid direct clicks do not damage another enemy
target removed from the registry releases the pin and falls back using the active mode
automatic killing blow immediately reselects according to each policy
out-of-range pinned targets never get attacked, even if another enemy is in range
automatic targeting and attacks never move the player, including empty and out-of-range states
reset restores configured HP/max HP, all player and target state, and default selection
default mode is configurable; unsupported modes fail without corrupting selection
